name: controltower
description: Amazon Web Services Control Tower offers application programming interface (API) operations that support programmatic interaction with these types of resources: Controls DisableControl EnableControl GetEnabledControl GetControlOperation ListControlOperations ListEnabledControls ResetEnabledControl UpdateEnabledControl Landing zones CreateLandingZone DeleteLandingZone GetLandingZone GetLandingZoneOperation ListLandingZones ListLandingZoneOperations ResetLandingZone UpdateLandingZone Baselines DisableBaseline EnableBaseline GetBaseline GetBaselineOperation GetEnabledBaseline ListBaselines ListEnabledBaselines ResetEnabledBaseline UpdateEnabledBaseline Tagging ListTagsForResource TagResource UntagResource For more information about these types of resources, see the Amazon Web Services Control Tower User Guide .

subcommands.name: create-landing-zone
subcommands.description: Creates a new landing zone.

subcommands.name: delete-landing-zone
subcommands.description: Decommissions a landing zone.

subcommands.name: disable-baseline
subcommands.description: Disable an EnabledBaseline resource on the specified Target.

subcommands.name: disable-control
subcommands.description: This API call turns off a control.

subcommands.name: enable-baseline
subcommands.description: Enable (apply) a Baseline to a Target.

subcommands.name: enable-control
subcommands.description: This API call activates a control.

subcommands.name: get-baseline
subcommands.description: Retrieve details about an existing Baseline resource by specifying its identifier.

subcommands.name: get-baseline-operation
subcommands.description: Returns the details of an asynchronous baseline operation, as initiated by any of these APIs: EnableBaseline, DisableBaseline, UpdateEnabledBaseline, ResetEnabledBaseline.

subcommands.name: get-control-operation
subcommands.description: Returns the status of a particular EnableControl or DisableControl operation.

subcommands.name: get-enabled-baseline
subcommands.description: Retrieve details of an EnabledBaseline resource by specifying its identifier.

subcommands.name: get-enabled-control
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an enabled control.

subcommands.name: get-landing-zone
subcommands.description: Returns details about the landing zone.

subcommands.name: get-landing-zone-operation
subcommands.description: Returns the status of the specified landing zone operation.

subcommands.name: list-baselines
subcommands.description: Returns a summary list of all available baselines.

subcommands.name: list-control-operations
subcommands.description: Provides a list of operations in progress or queued.

subcommands.name: list-enabled-baselines
subcommands.description: Returns a list of summaries describing EnabledBaseline resources.

subcommands.name: list-enabled-controls
subcommands.description: Lists the controls enabled by Amazon Web Services Control Tower on the specified organizational unit and the accounts it contains.

subcommands.name: list-landing-zone-operations
subcommands.description: Lists all landing zone operations from the past 90 days.

subcommands.name: list-landing-zones
subcommands.description: Returns the landing zone ARN for the landing zone deployed in your managed account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags associated with the resource.

subcommands.name: reset-enabled-baseline
subcommands.description: Re-enables an EnabledBaseline resource.

subcommands.name: reset-enabled-control
subcommands.description: Resets an enabled control.

subcommands.name: reset-landing-zone
subcommands.description: This API call resets a landing zone.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies tags to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-enabled-baseline
subcommands.description: Updates an EnabledBaseline resource's applied parameters or version.

subcommands.name: update-enabled-control
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an already enabled control.

subcommands.name: update-landing-zone
subcommands.description: This API call updates the landing zone.
